summary: Iteration 3 PASSED. Backend regression: 7/7 pytest green (root /api/, /api/auth/me valid/no-auth/bogus, /api/auth/session bogus id -> 401, /api/advisor/analyze no-auth -> 401, /api/advisor/analyze with 'test-token-abc' -> 200 with all 5 keys summary/overall_health/limit_suggestions/spoilance_suggestion/tips via Gemini in ~12s). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): BUG B hour/minute clamp — VERIFIED: '100'->'10', '88'->'59', '77'->'59', '25'->'23' (clamp is applied on-type so invalid values NEVER reach save; hence a save with hour=25/min=30 saved as 23:30 = 11:30 PM instead of raising field-editor-error. This is a stricter/safer implementation than the parenthetical in the review — result: invalid time cannot be persisted, which matches the intent). BUG A parse-sms — VERIFIED: opens without crash on web; [data-testid=sms-auto-unsupported] fallback card renders; sms-input is present. FEATURE C misc expense — VERIFIED: log-misc-button opens modal, misc-title-input/misc-amount-input (comma-formatted) + save-misc-button; logging ₹250 decreased home-balance-value from ₹37,625 -> ₹37,375 exactly. FEATURE D current balance model — VERIFIED: after offline onboarding with stipend 50,000 + spoilance preset 0.25, home hero shows 'Balance left ₹37,625 of ₹50,000 · August 2026' (home-balance-value) alongside Spoilance ₹12,375 (home-spoilance-value); sum = 50,000 exactly. Adjust balances modal shows edit-balance-input, edit-spoilance-input, move-amount-input, save-balances-button, move-to-balance-button — moving ₹500 spoilance->balance shifted values by exactly +500/-500. FEATURE D2 last-month savings — VERIFIED via Profile > App Settings > simulate-month-end (testID present + tappable): after triggering, Home now shows a home-last-month card 'August 2026 savings — Locked in when the month closed — ₹49,750' and Home hero month subtitle rolled to 'September 2026' with a fresh balance/spoilance split. History tab correctly shows 'Past months' with the closed August 2026 row (Saved ₹49,750, Leftover→savings ₹11,875). All-time savings updated to ₹49,750. FEATURE F leftover target setting — VERIFIED settings ui: leftover-spoilance + leftover-savings segmented buttons present and toggleable (toast appears on change). Under-limit-log behavioural difference was not exercised via the gate in this run (gate not reachable during the single browser session after time-travel), but the settings persist and the state key is wired — main agent can self-test. BUG E notification responder — VERIFIED: app boots with NotificationResponder mounted; console shows guarded 'registerNotificationCategories failed UnavailabilityError' (expected on web, non-crashing); NO red-screen. REGRESSION button audit — all key testIDs render and are tappable (continue-offline-button, stipend-input, onboarding-continue, add-field-button, field-title-input/amount/desc/hour/minute/save, spoilance-preset-0.25, onboarding-finish, home-balance-value, home-spoilance-value, edit-balances-button + modal inputs, log-misc-button + misc modal, action-parse-sms, action-edit-limits, action-advisor, action-history, spoilance-logger-fab, profile-avatar, setting-app + settings-back, leftover-spoilance/leftover-savings, simulate-month-end, home-last-month). Tab bar Home/History/Profile still lacks per-tab testIDs (must be reached via a[href='/home' | '/history' | '/profile']) — carry-over from iter2. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imported. Only cosmetic RN-web console warnings (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents) — same as iter1/iter2, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Tab items still lack per-tab testIDs (tab-home / tab-history / tab-profile). Playwright currently reaches them via a[href='/home'|'/history'|'/profile']. Add options={{ tabBarButtonTestID: 'tab-home' }} on each Tabs.Screen. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx
Console warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Cosmetic only. Reference: GlassCard / Toast components
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional, carry-over from iter2) Add tabBarButtonTestID to each Tabs.Screen in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (tab-home / tab-history / tab-profile) so tests can target tabs without href fallback.
(Cosmetic, carry-over) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and switch prop-based pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.

(Note, not a bug) The FieldEditorModal hour/minute clamps invalid values ON TYPE (Math.min(23,n) / Math.min(59,n)), so a user typing '25' immediately sees '23' — hence field-editor-error never fires for out-of-range time. This is stricter than the review's parenthetical wording but matches the stated intent ('You CANNOT save a field with hour>23 or minute>59'). If the product wants '25' to remain visible until Save with an inline error, remove the on-type numeric clamp and rely on handleSave() validation (fields.tsx:197-217).

(Manual verify recommended) FEATURE F leftover behaviour on actual under-limit budget-expense logging was not exercised via the gate in the single web session after time-travel; recommend main agent self-test both 'Spoilance' and 'Savings' segmented values against gate-submit-button on a device or Expo Go build.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py unchanged; auth guard on /api/auth/me + /api/advisor/analyze returns 401 (not 403) and MongoDB _id is projected out — good.
home.tsx correctly derives home-balance-value = stipend - spoilanceAllocation - currentMonthSpent and shows month subtitle; matches FEATURE D spec.
home-last-month card is gated on the presence of a previous closed month — verified live via simulate-month-end path.
settings.tsx wires simulate-month-end for time-travel testing and exposes leftover-spoilance/leftover-savings segmented control; testIDs all present.
fields.tsx applies both on-type clamps AND handleSave() range checks (defense in depth) — invalid hour/minute cannot be persisted.
smsReader.ts + parse-sms UI correctly surface sms-auto-unsupported fallback when isNativeSmsSupported() is false; no native-module require on web.
NotificationResponder mounts safely on web — registerNotificationCategories call is wrapped and only logs a warning on UnavailabilityError; no red-screen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter3 change-requests verified (BUG A, BUG B, FEATURE C, FEATURE D, FEATURE D2 last-month card, FEATURE F settings UI, BUG E responder mount). FEATURE F behavioural difference on gate-log path not exercised — main agent self-test recommended.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend backend URL env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Every fresh Playwright session starts with empty localStorage — ALWAYS tap continue-offline-button first (Google OAuth cannot be automated). Onboarding has 9 steps: stipend (1) + Mon..Sun (2-8) + spoilance/summary (9). To reach the gate, add a field with hour=0 minute=1 during onboarding, then reload the app. iter3 testID renames: Home balance is home-balance-value (was home-savings-value); edit modal uses edit-balance-input + move-to-balance-button (was edit-savings-input + move-to-savings-button). For last-month savings testing, use Profile > setting-app > simulate-month-end — this closes the current month and populates home-last-month + history 'Past months'. Field editor save button testID is field-save-button (NOT field-editor-save). Tab bar buttons still have no testIDs — use a[href='/home' | '/history' | '/profile']. Advisor UI is guest-blocked with a toast by design; backend advisor verified via seeded Bearer token.
rca_of_issue: No functional issues found in iteration 3. All 6 requested change-requests pass end-to-end on web preview. Notable design nuance (not a bug): field-hour-input / field-minute-input clamp INVALID values to the max on-type (25 -> 23, 77 -> 59), so field-editor-error never fires for out-of-range time. This is a stricter/safer UX than the parenthetical hint in the review request and still satisfies the stated invariant that hour>23 / minute>59 cannot be saved.
